decision: One new Kumo Medium candidate; no size/weight sweep.

local_inventory.TabPFN: V2 default1/2/8/32 views, feature-token architectures and adaptation already tested; newer generations remain outside existing license clearance.
local_inventory.TabICL: v2-20260212 already tested compact/engineered4; software2.2.1 is not a new model generation.
local_inventory.other: Mitra1/2 and adaptations, TabM/FTT/TabR/SCARF/MLP/EBM/AutoGluon evaluated; TabDPTv1.3 evaluated separately.

code.vendored: Unmodified sdm code plus original licenses/metadata; no pip installation of moving main.

choice.reason: Predeclared local resource choice, not an author recommendation or validation-selected winner.
choice.architecture: 6 alternating column/row embedding layers, cell256, four readout tokens, 24 ICL layers width512, 8 query heads /2 query-KV heads; Fourier embeddings, learned context-length temperature.
choice.context: Full4636 outer-training and8693 final-training rows; no context sampling.
choice.inputs: Same compact13 with explicit six categorical columns, no ID/name, raw missingness retained.
choice.aggregation: Unchanged official recipe: per-view output alignment, mean logits then softmax.

provenance.statement: NVIDIA authors state entirely artificial SCM tables; no real competition labels reported in pretraining.
provenance.limit: Author provenance only, not an independent checkpoint data audit. No competition test answers or external predictions accessed.

backend.preprocessing: Original recipe float64 on CPU; fit_transform sees training context only, transform sees queries.
backend.bridge: Official Callback hooks move final FP32 context/query/labels to selected model device and logits back to CPU for unchanged output recipe.
backend.neural: FP32 parameters and execution; AMP disabled. Native torch SDPA including Test-GQA unchanged.
backend.cache: Uncached forward; sequential estimator_batch_size1; no eight persistent context caches.
backend.fallback: No CPU fallback, no unsupported-op fallback, no precision/context reduction on failure.
risk: MPS native SDPA enable_gqa unproven until scheduled resource probe.
Official non-CUDA auto batch limit is65535; no assumption of memory safety from that estimator.
Smaller weight size is not proof full-context attention fits16GB.
Pipeline bridge requires actual CPU equality and MPS resource tests, not assumed official MPS support.

compatibility.scope: One pinned official Kumo CellEmbedding instance receives a MethodType _forward wrapper; no global torch patch or vendor edits.
compatibility.operation: On MPS only, with out provided, call original Kumo CellEmbedding._forward with out=None (including original projection bias and nan_lin order), then copy completed result to original output and return it. CPU and out=None dispatch unchanged.
compatibility.source_guard: Exact class plus SHA256 of both Kumo and inherited TabFM cell_embedding source; exactly one binding, idempotent; state_dict, parameters and eval mode unchanged.

local_diagnosis.limitation: These diagnostics used a temporary global matmul guard, not the new instance-local wrapper; they do not qualify the new implementation.

compatibility.rejected_switch: PYTORCH_MPS_PREFER_METAL=1 did not fix local numerical errors and is not part of this compatibility recipe.
compatibility.historical_failure: reports/kumo_resources/full_mps_failed and original probe evidence remain unchanged.
compatibility.resource_status: The extra projection allocation may increase peak memory. Repeat true CPU and full-context MPS probes in new directories before qualification; original 2e-5 tolerance and exact threshold agreement unchanged.

checks: Source/env/checkpoint freeze before model work; MPS only after source commit.
FP32 official CPU vs callback equality.
Full-query vs two disjoint query partitions, keeping all support each time.
Every ensemble forwards all declared support rows.
Portable CPU state/context joblib restore recreates model without downloader.
Finite normalized binary probabilities, threshold agreement and maxdiff tolerance2e-5.
RSS peak and accelerator memory snapshots/time; resource interruption is inconclusive.
probe.limit: Large1view probe does not establish full8view runtime; full8 must be validated before formal candidate screening.
probe.mps_status: Original baseline failed numerical partition check; instance-local workaround awaits fresh complete resource probes, including full eight-view qualification.

dependencies: Isolated .venv-kumo: Python3.12, torch2.13, numpy,pandas,pyarrow,huggingface_hub,safetensors,typing_extensions,joblib,pytest. No CUDA extras/tokenizer/API account.
